main_message: Three-site pathway comparison linking pristine Co32 Al-modified neighboring Co7 and Al47 control
Al strongly suppresses the Co-centered population response while substantial O-centered oxidation response remains
Al reduces Co-centered spin response and is accompanied by stronger O-centered spin reorganization
Co plus adsorbate hole localization is favored over Co-only localization and Al raises the valid Co-only M+2 penalty at *O
Validated bonding analysis supports the origin of altered Co-O response
Spatial density redistribution complements cDFT response
Spatial spin pattern supports the spin-reorganization interpretation
Frontier-state character supports the bonding mechanism without raw-band-index claims
Net charge partition is supporting context and does not define oxidation state
